title: Hidden Prompt Injection in Brazilian Labor-Court Petition Reportedly Tried to Manipulate Galileu

behaviors.text: Galileu, an AI tool used by Brazil's labor courts, reportedly detected hidden instructions embedded in an initial petition before the 3rd Labor Court of Parauapebas.
Galileu reportedly alerted the judge and blocked the hidden content from processing; the judge then reviewed the material before imposing any procedural consequences.
